title.value: Latest stop for each pharmaceutical treatment

description.value:
This operation determines, for a given patient, the latest stop building block (either a MedicationAgreement (MA), an AdministrationAgreement (TA) or VariableDosingRegimen (WDS)) for each pharmaceutical treatment based on the value in the extension ext-RegistrationDateTime. When invoked by clients, servers SHALL serve it's own latest stopped medication building block (specified by the resource type and the parameter named `category`) wherein the ext-Stoptype extension is present and has the SNOMED code '410546004' and display 'stopgezet'.
If requested (e.g. via the include parameter), the server MAY also return the underlying MedicationAgreement, AdministrationAgreement or VariableDosingRegimen resources and secondary resources that were used to determine the latest stopped building block(s).

purpose.value: To provide a deterministic, server-side application of the query parameter 'LatestStop' and the business rule 'latest stop for each pharmaceutical treatment' in the MedicationProcess, so that clients can obtain a consistent view of stopped medication without having to reimplement stop logic themselves.

documentation.value: Patient identifier for whom the latest stopped building block should be determined (e.g. BSN) based on subject element in the resource. The parameter is optional but the operation SHALL be executed including a patient identification mechanism.

Required parameter to support routing and targeted source querying based on the category element in the resource. The server SHALL limit evaluation to the relevant medication process building blocks (either MedicationAgreement/MA, AdministrationAgreement/TA or VariableDosingRegimen/WDS) in that category, according to MP9 conventions.

Optional restriction to one or more specific pharmaceutical treatment identifiers and is based on the extension ext-PharmaceuticalTreatment.Identifier in the resource. If omitted, the server SHALL determine it's own latest stopped building blocks for all pharmaceutical treatments in the source system for the given patient.

Optional parameter to support the existing search result parameters _include and _include:iterate with the operation and to add resources to include in the search results in the bundle that search matches point to.

Bundle containing the results after applying the latest stop logic for the given patient and category or any additional parameters.
When the operation is invoked in the context of a specific category (MedicationAgreement/MA, AdministrationAgreement/TA or VariableDosingRegimen/WDS), the Bundle SHALL contain the server's own latest stopped building block of each pharmaceutical treatment.
